item.title: Modest Mouse’s Reverb Shop Returns with a Well-Worn ‘63 Danelectro Bass and Other Touring Instruments
item.description: Modest Mouse is reopening their Reverb shop, offering a well-worn ’63 Danelectro bass and other touring instruments used across decades of shows.

item.title: Tetsu Yamauchi, Bassist for Free and The Faces, Dies at 79
item.description: Tetsu Yamauchi, bassist for Free and The Faces, has died at 79. His family shared the news as fans remember his era-defining work in both bands.

item.title: Billy Strings’ Tiny Desk Set Showcases Upright Bass Power from Royal Masat
item.description: Billy Strings delivers a tight Tiny Desk set with Royal Masat’s upright bass bringing warmth, drive, and definition for listeners who love acoustic low end.

item.title: Mike Dirnt Reflects on "Warning" at 25, His Evolving Bass Approach, and What Music Gives Back
item.description: Green Day’s Mike Dirnt reflects on Warning at 25, his evolving bass approach, daily playing habits, and how music continues to ground and inspire him.

item.title: “The Amonklok Conquest”: Amon Amarth and Dethklok Unite for a 2026 Tour Packed With Crushing Bass
item.description: Amon Amarth and Dethklok unite for “The Amonklok Conquest,” a 2026 North American tour featuring Castle Rat and three powerhouse bassists.

item.title: Vulfpeck’s “MSG II” Hits YouTube as the Vinyl Release Highlights Joe Dart’s Live Mastery
item.description: Joe Dart’s tone and bass work shine throughout Vulfpeck’s MSG II, now streaming in full and released on vinyl for listeners wanting a deeper look at the performance.

item.title: JHS and Electro-Harmonix Unearth the “Lost” Big Muff 2, With Massive Low End for Bass
item.description: The “Lost” Big Muff returns as JHS and Electro-Harmonix unveil the Big Muff 2, a newly discovered Op-Amp fuzz with huge bass response.

item.title: Behringer Introduces the Meatball Envelope Filter With Expression Control and Effects Loop
item.description: Behringer has unveiled the Meatball, a fully analog envelope filter based on a classic with extensive controls, dual expression inputs, and an onboard effects loop.

item.title: "Reflection" A Trio with Two 6 String Basses and Synth Finds a New Sound in Nature
item.description: Reflection brings two 6 string bassists together with RO1 on synth for a layered and melodic trio piece that highlights texture, space and a modern bass driven sound.

item.title: Alabama Shakes Return to the Road in 2026 With Zac Cockrell Back on Bass
item.description: Alabama Shakes will continue their reunion into 2026 with new U.S. and European tour dates, featuring Zac Cockrell back on bass.
